All standard due-diligence domains are unverified due to absent inputs: CAPEX vs. cost benchmarks, contracted vs. executed capacity (MW/MWh), schedule dates vs. permitting milestones, site control claims vs. title evidence, and schedule vs. equipment lead times.

rfis: Site control: executed leases/options for all parcels and the gen-tie corridor, APN schedule with acreage (site_acres is null; 100 MW needs ~570-600 ac), preliminary title reports, ALTA survey, and landowner estoppels.
Zoning file: current zoning and General Plan designations per APN, Williamson Act contract status, FMMP prime-farmland mapping, SOAR applicability, and all Ventura County RMA correspondence.

BOC evidence under Notice 2025-42 (physical work test only, no 5% safe harbor above 1.5 MW): executed contracts, binding equipment orders, invoices, dated photos, and work logs proving BOC before Jul 4, 2026, plus tax counsel memo; ~$43-47M solar ITC at stake.
Storage sizing: BESS MW/MWh, duration, chemistry, and augmentation plan; confirm >=200 MWh (CEC Opt-In threshold) and >=4-hour duration (90-95% NQC vs ~10% solar-only).
Interconnection: CAISO queue position, cluster phase, Phase I/II study reports, POI, deliverability election (FCDS vs Energy-Only), network-upgrade cost allocation, and gen-tie route.
Offtake: executed PPAs (not LOIs) with counterparty, tenor, price, percent of P50 contracted, and RA allocation; benchmark is >=80% P50, tenor of debt plus 2 years, price >= ~$64.49/MWh.
Financials: full CAPEX budget (benchmark $1.43-1.56/Wac PV; BESS $200-350/kWh), sources and uses, model with DSCR at P50/P90 (1.20x P90 floor), COD schedule, and 10-15% escalation assumptions.

Equipment: module, inverter, GSU transformer, switchgear, and BESS quotes or supply agreements with delivery dates; transformer lead times run 128-144 weeks and switchgear 60-100+ weeks, so provide order confirmations and slot reservations; include Section 232 (50%) and AD/CVD tariff posture and domestic-content strategy.
Permitting: applications filed or planned, CEQA status, CEC Opt-In pre-application under AB 205, and a permitting matrix (local route 18-36 months plus EIR 12-24 months).

Biological surveys: all completed surveys (BUOW, SWHA, CTS), jurisdictional delineation, and schedule against windows (BUOW 4 visits Apr 15-Jul 15; SWHA blackout Apr 21-Jun 10; CTS 2 wet seasons); a missed season adds ~1 year.
Fire safety: NFPA 855 compliance, UL 9540A test reports, emergency response plan, and Ventura County Fire Protection District correspondence.
Cultural/tribal: AB 52 consultation status, NAHC Sacred Lands File search, and cultural resources study; consultation must conclude before EIR certification.
Water/stormwater: Construction General Permit enrollment in SMARTS, draft SWPPP, construction water source, and any CDFW Sec. 1602 LSAA or 404/401 needs.
Decommissioning plan with engineer's cost estimate for bond sizing (~100% of removal cost), plus community benefits agreement and local opposition assessment.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Resource Management Agency (RMA), Planning Division
agency_actions.action: Obtain written zoning verification for every APN and the gen-tie corridor, confirming whether utility-scale solar/BESS is permitted, conditional, or prohibited, plus General Plan and SOAR consistency.
agency_actions.why: Kill criterion: zoning unverified and CA ag-county precedent (Solano ZT 12-04; Ord. 2025-1864 banning BESS on ag land) shows a potential kill switch; if ag-zoned, CEC Opt-In is the only path.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Agricultural Commissioner and CA Dept. of Conservation, Division of Land Resource Protection
agency_actions.action: Confirm Williamson Act contract status; if contracted, scope 9-year nonrenewal vs cancellation at 12.5% FMV (25% in Farmland Security Zones).
agency_actions.why: Incompatible use on contracted land triggers multi-year exit or 12.5-25% FMV penalty; prime farmland triggers LESA with likely significant-and-unavoidable impact and 1:1 (2:1 prime) easement mitigation.

agency_actions.agency: California Energy Commission (CEC), Opt-In Certification Program (AB 205, Pub. Res. Code Sec. 25545)
agency_actions.action: Request pre-application meeting and file notice of intent; confirm eligibility (solar >=50 MW met; storage >=200 MWh must be evidenced) and map the 270-day certification clock.
agency_actions.why: Opt-In is the fallback if Ventura zoning fails and compresses permitting vs an 18-36 month local route with full EIR and ~43% plaintiff win rate if litigated.
agency_actions.deadline: Pre-app meeting in 30 days; go/no-go in 60 days

agency_actions.action: Verify queue position, cluster phase, study status, POI, deliverability election, and network-upgrade allocation directly; confirm standing under the reformed cluster process and 150% zonal intake cap.
agency_actions.why: Queue unverified in a >500 GW queue with ~20% COD rate, ~5-year IR-to-COD, and network-upgrade shock as the top attrition driver; Energy-Only status blocks RA sales.

agency_actions.agency: Southern California Edison (SCE), Transmission and Interconnection
agency_actions.action: Confirm POI feasibility, gen-tie route and easements, service terms, and SCE-side upgrade scope and schedule.
agency_actions.why: SCE controls physical interconnection; its upgrade scope and timeline gate COD and must reconcile with CAISO studies and 128-144 week transformer lead times.

agency_actions.agency: CA Dept. of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW), South Coast Region 5
agency_actions.action: Engage on CESA take strategy for candidate burrowing owl (Sec. 2081 ITP), Sec. 1602 LSAA scope, and protocol survey concurrence.
agency_actions.why: Burrowing owl has take protection now as a CESA candidate; surveys need 4 visits Apr 15-Jul 15 and a missed window adds ~1 year.
agency_actions.deadline: Engage by Mar 15, 2026 so surveys start Apr 15, 2026

agency_actions.agency: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Ventura Fish and Wildlife Office
agency_actions.action: Request technical assistance on MBTA, ESA needs (CTS requires 2 wet seasons; condor occurs in Ventura County), and raptor survey protocols.
agency_actions.why: MBTA is strict liability; CTS protocol gates the schedule; early alignment prevents a late ESA stop-work.
agency_actions.deadline: 45 days; CTS sampling must begin with the 2026-27 wet season

agency_actions.action: Obtain Sacred Lands File search and AB 52 tribal contact list; support lead agency in initiating consultation.
agency_actions.why: AB 52 consultation must conclude before EIR certification; late starts are a common cause of multi-month CEQA delay.

agency_actions.agency: State Water Resources Control Board (SMARTS) and Los Angeles Regional Water Board (Region 4)
agency_actions.action: Enroll under the Construction General Permit (Order 2022-0057-DWQ) with site-specific SWPPP; scope any Sec. 401 certification.
agency_actions.why: CGP coverage is a precondition to the ground disturbance needed for the Jul 4, 2026 BOC deadline; Ventura is in Region 4.
agency_actions.deadline: Enrollment complete by Jun 1, 2026 to protect the BOC window

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Fire Protection District, Fire Prevention Bureau
agency_actions.action: Submit BESS design for fire code review under NFPA 855 with UL 9540A data and emergency response plan; obtain written sign-off.
agency_actions.why: Fire sign-off is unaddressed and gates BESS permitting and insurability in a high-fire-risk county.

agency_actions.agency: FAA (Obstruction Evaluation) and DoD Siting Clearinghouse
agency_actions.action: File Form 7460-1 if structures or glare are near Camarillo/Oxnard airports or NAS Point Mugu; request DoD radar and flight-path review.
agency_actions.why: Point Mugu and county airports create glare/radar exposure; a late adverse determination can force redesign.

agency_actions.action: Scope encroachment permits for gen-tie or access crossings of state highways and heavy-haul permits for transformer delivery.
agency_actions.why: State right-of-way crossings need Caltrans approval and 128-144 week transformer deliveries require route planning on the critical path.

verification_requests: Offtake: confirm directly with the named buyer that the PPA is executed (not LOI); verify tenor, price, percent of P50, RA allocation, curtailment terms, and counterparty credit against the >=80% P50, debt-plus-2-year, >=~$64.49/MWh benchmark.

CAISO and SCE: verify queue position, cluster phase, Phase I/II results, POI, deliverability (FCDS vs Energy-Only), and network-upgrade allocation directly with CAISO; confirm POI and upgrade scope with SCE; do not rely on developer summaries.

GSU transformer OEMs (Hitachi Energy, Siemens Energy, GE Vernova, Hyundai): written confirmation of production slot, lead time vs the 128-144 week norm, price ($3-8M/unit), and cancellation terms; verify claimed orders by PO number.
Switchgear suppliers: verify lead times against the 60-100+ week norm and confirm slot reservations in writing.
Module supplier: verify pricing ($0.34-0.40/W import vs $0.56/W US), Section 232 (50%) and AD/CVD exposure, domestic-content certification, and delivery alignment with the Jul 4, 2026 BOC date.
BESS integrator (Tesla, Fluence, Sungrow, CATL): verify UL 9540A reports for the exact cell model, lead time, augmentation and warranty terms, and NFPA 855 documentation.

Title company: preliminary title reports confirming no encumbrances, mineral severances, or easement conflicts on all parcels and the gen-tie; landowner estoppels confirming execution and no defaults.

Independent engineer (DNV, UL Solutions, Wood Mackenzie): validate CAPEX vs benchmarks ($1.43-1.56/Wac PV; $200-350/kWh BESS), P50/P90 yield, 11.5% curtailment assumption, and battery merchant revenue at 2025 levels ($52/kW-yr, down from $115 in 2022).

Tax counsel: independent BOC opinion under Notice 2025-42 confirming the physical work test is met before Jul 4, 2026 and the ~$43-47M solar ITC is preserved; confirm storage Sec. 48E treatment separately.
conditions_precedent: Zoning kill-switch clearance: written Ventura County RMA verification that no parcel prohibits utility-scale solar/BESS, OR a filed and accepted CEC Opt-In application with storage >=200 MWh evidenced.

BOC proof: tax counsel opinion and documentary evidence that the Notice 2025-42 physical work test is met before Jul 4, 2026; no reliance on the 5% safe harbor; failure forfeits ~$43-47M ITC and kills the deal.
Executed offtake: PPA(s) covering >=80% of P50, tenor >= debt plus 2 years, price >= ~$64.49/MWh, RA allocation consistent with Slice-of-Day; LOIs do not satisfy this condition.

Interconnection certainty: CAISO Phase II study in hand with network-upgrade allocation within an agreed cap and FCDS deliverability confirmed; Energy-Only is disqualifying absent a merchant case clearing DSCR.
Site control: executed leases/options for >=570-600 net acres plus gen-tie corridor, clean title, and estoppels for every parcel.

Williamson Act resolution: documented path (nonrenewal, cancellation at 12.5-25% FMV, or compatibility finding) for any contracted parcel, with LESA completed and easement mitigation (1:1, 2:1 prime) and decommissioning bond (~100% of removal) budgeted.
Storage configuration: BESS >=4-hour duration and >=200 MWh with NQC analysis showing 90-95% and hybrid QC vs POI validated; solar-only (~10% NQC) is disqualifying.

Equipment critical path: executed supply agreements with locked slots for GSU transformers (128-144 weeks) and switchgear (60-100+ weeks) with delivery supporting committed COD; tariff and domestic-content strategy documented.

Biological schedule lock: CDFW/USFWS engagement complete and surveys funded so BUOW visits occur Apr 15-Jul 15, SWHA avoids the Apr 21-Jun 10 blackout, and CTS sampling begins next wet season; a missed window moves COD ~1 year and reprices the deal.
Bankability: model showing DSCR >=1.20x at P90, CAPEX within benchmark, revenue underwritten to 2025 conditions (11.5% curtailment; $52/kW-yr merchant), and sensitivity to network-upgrade shock.
Fire sign-off: Ventura County Fire Protection District written acceptance of BESS design under NFPA 855 with UL 9540A data and approved emergency response plan.

Environmental path fixed: CEQA strategy chosen (CEC Opt-In or local EIR), AB 52 consultation initiated and concluded before EIR certification, CGP enrollment and SWPPP complete before any ground disturbance.
